posts.content: ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle: A ComfyUI custom node for 3D camera angle control. Provides an interactive Three.js viewport to adjust camera angles and outputs formatted prompt strings for multi-angle image generation.

ai.title: ComfyUI node for 3D camera control with Three.js viewport for multi-angle prompts
ai.summary: Custom ComfyUI node provides interactive Three.js viewport for adjusting 3D camera angles. Outputs formatted prompt strings for multi-angle image generation workflows.
ai.why_important: Bridges 3D camera control and AI image generation with visual angle previews directly in ComfyUI.
ai.learnings: Interactive 3D viewport can drive prompt generation for consistent multi-angle renders in image generation pipelines.

posts.content: bloub: SVG recreation of the x.ai bot avatar. One shape morphing through 14 states, measured off the reference video frame by frame.

ai.title: SVG recreation of the x.ai bot avatar. One shape morphing through 14 states, measured off the reference video frame by frame
ai.summary: Frame-by-frame recreation of x.ai bot avatar using single SVG shape morphing through 14 states. Measured directly from reference video for precision.
ai.why_important: Demonstrates practical reverse-engineering technique for recreating complex morphing animations using SVG.
ai.learnings: Single-shape SVG morphing with frame-accurate measurement can replicate complex character animations efficiently.
